SK Hynix is hoping to raise $28 billion via the share sale, the largest such foreign listing in history.

Demand for the US sale is running at seven times the available shares, per reports from Reuters, underscoring the huge interest in a share sale seen as the largest first-share sale ever.

Users are opting out of Meta's new Muse Image AI feature on Instagram, a default setting that allows people to use their photos to generate images with AI.

SAG-AFTRA and Hollywood are speaking out about the new AI development.

Video

SK Hynix will make its US market debut on Friday. 

The IPO consists of 177.9 million ADS, also called American depositary receipts, priced at $149 each. Each represents one-tenth of a share of the company's common stock, or 17.79 million shares, that will trade under the ticker symbol $SKHY.
